author: ojiudezue
title: HVAC arc consolidated into 4 workstreams behind a mandatory read-first state-of-play doc; W1 is one thermostat definition per BRAND
summary: Operator approved W1 thermostat definition (per-brand strategy owning write, borrow/return and READ — not per zone; Carrier first, generic default, Nest when testable), W2 occupancy truth (occupancy fast path first — designed in 82620357a, never built; scope = shave the 5-min tick only), W3 energy-aware, W4 closure. docs/Coordinator/HVAC_ARCHITECTURE_STATE_OF_PLAY.md was written from a forensic review of v5.103.0-.14 + code, and is now mandatory complete reading (CLAUDE.md 5b + all ura-* agent definitions).
why: The session made ~15 wrong HVAC claims from stale memos, READMEs and partial greps (e.g. step-4-B 'unshipped' — it shipped v5.103.7 with reset-only night protection the operator decided in round 4; '1-min occupancy tick' — the fast path was never built). Operator: prevent drift and compaction-driven errors; 'problems before cards' and consolidate 'or we will never get done'.
implications: Any HVAC plan/build/review starts by reading the state-of-play doc; its §10 corrections ledger must never be re-asserted; every HVAC ship updates it. Room Override Occupied/Vacant stay as-is (not hard HVAC inputs; documented §9c). ha_carrier.set_activity_setpoint is an UPSTREAM no-hold service (#427), usable by W1 with restore ownership.
revisit_trigger: Revisit the W1 staging (A behaviour-neutral funnel+logging, B brand definition, Tier 3) if Stage A's write log shows a different dominant strand cause.
